quote.text: I need a bill tracker that shows what I have paid

promise.text: Monthly bills list: include the bills that are not monthly

art.why: the carousel's topic: the moment and its guide name "list"

lines.text: A six column list, plus the math for turning quarterly and annual bills into a monthly amount: $612 every three months is $204 a month.

head.text: Open three months of statements and pull out every charge that repeated, with its amount.

body.text: It won't catch the rest, which is what the next pass is for.

head.text: Add the bills that don't come monthly.

art.why: the slide names nothing drawable; the carousel's topic (the moment and its guide name "list")

head.text: Write a due day against every row: the day of the month for monthly bills, a real date for the others.

body.text: Anything you can't date goes on a short second list titled find the date, because a bill with no date can't be planned around.

line.text: Bills you tick paid for the month, with what is left to pay worked out from the ticks.

title.text: Monthly bills list: include the bills that are not monthly
